simple.meaning: אֵבֶל (ʼêbel) is a Hebrew object word meaning “lamentation.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 27:41. The surrounding context includes family, family line, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵבֶל (H60) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֵבֶל (ʼêbel) / H60 is traced through Genesis 27:41, Genesis 50:10, Genesis 50:11, Deuteronomy 34:8 with generated occurrence evidence.

When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife, and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.

Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil, but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.
The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a good day; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.
Therefore my harp has turned to mourning,
It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.
The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
Your sun will not go down any more,
to provide for those who mourn in Zion,
Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.
Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance;
The joy of our heart has ceased.
Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

definitions.full: H60. ebel אֵ֫בֶל noun masculine Gen 50:11 mourning — absolute 50:10 17 t.; construct 27:41 3 t.; אֶבְלֵךְ Isa 60:20 ; אֶבְלָם Jer 31:13 — for dead, construct Gen 27:41 ; Deut 34:8 (|| בּכי ) so ׳א יָחִיד simile for grievous mourning Amos 8:10 , id. metaphor Jer 6:26 (|| תַּמְרוּרִים מִסְמַּד ); Gen 50:11 (twice in verse); Jer 16:7 compare 2Sam 19:3 א ׳עשה Ezek 24:17 (see Co) followed by לְ Gen 50:10 (see also II. אָבֵל near the end); for calamity, Est 4:3 ; 9:22 (|| יָגוֺן ; contracted טוֺב יוֺם ) Job 30:31 (|| בכים קול Isa 60:20 ; 61:3 (where apparently = mourning garb, followed by תְהִלָּה מַעֲטֵה , see also Bi Che on text.; || כֵּהָה רוּחַ ; contracted שָׂשׂוֺן שֶׁמֶן ); Jer 31:13 (|| שׂשׂון ), Lam 5:15 (|| מָחוֺל ), Amos 5:16 (|| מִסְמֵּד ); compare ׳א יַעֲנָה כִּבְנוֺת Micah 1:8 ; = time, period of mourning 2Sam 11:7 ; א ׳בֵּית Eccl 7:2 (|| מִשְׁתֶּה ׳בּ , 7:4 (|| ׳בּ שִׂמְחָה ); א ׳בִּגְדֵי garments of mourning 2Sam 14:2 . מִצְרַיִם אֵבֶל see מ ׳אָבֵל below II. אבל .
